summary: Acushnet Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K to disclose a $52.5 million stock repurchase agreement with Magnus Holdings Co., Ltd., a significant shareholder. Under the accord, Acushnet will buy shares from Magnus on a share-for-share basis as it repurchases stock in the open market or privately, with the price tied to the average purchase price over defined periods. The program runs through September 30, 2026, and is part of a $1.25 billion existing authorization. The board implicitly supports the buyback; no advisors are named. Watch for execution pace and any material adverse change condition that could halt repurchases. Risk-arb angle: limited, as this is an issuer buyback, not a tender or third-party deal.
